admin_key_help: Administration key (nb3a_…) or your invite code (NB3-…), which opens the sub-administration console. You enter it once: the session lasts 30 days from the last use, and the key itself is not stored by the page. If the browser offers to save it, you can accept.
bulk_help: One image per line: identifier, name and template separated by TAB.
command_locked: Locked by the contest organization ({field} is locked in the model)
config_intro: These settings apply to every machine booting this image. They take effect on the next boot.
confirm_delete: Delete image "{id}"? This cannot be undone.
console_help: The same invite code opens your sub-administration console, where you create and manage your own models and site-images.
create_done: Image created! Save these details — they won't be shown again.
create_intro: Each image is a system your machines download at boot. With an invite code you create yours right away; without a code, request access and administration releases it.
create_name_help: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen. Names starting with a digit are reserved for administration.
dash_disk_none: No machine has reported disk yet (new agent arrives on next boot).
dash_empty: No sites visible — log in to the console.
dash_hw_best: Sites with most RAM per machine
dash_hw_worst: Sites with least RAM per machine
dash_share_help: The shared key only READS the aggregates: it cannot open hotconfig nor run commands. Good for big screens and broadcasts.
dash_share_once: Save the URL now — the key is not shown again. To change it, revoke and create another.
dash_shared_note: Shared view: per-machine detail not available.
dash_zoom_trend: Site RAM and CPU (average of powered-on)
dashboard_hidden_help: Not counted in the fleet board or charts (test image)
fleet_card_help: Machines up at every site, commands on any slice (one site, several, or individual machines) and the report of how many ran in the last days.
fleet_confirm_type: This affects {n} machines. To confirm, type the number:
home_admin_bad: Invalid key or code. Use the eye button to check what was pasted.
home_admin_desc: I'll create images, generate credentials and run the infrastructure. Invite-code holders come in here too, into their own console. The session lasts 30 days from the last use.
home_admin_logged: You are in administration as {who}. Session valid until {until}.
home_admin_remember: If the browser offers to save the key, accept: the password manager is the right place for it.
home_admin_wait: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
home_coord_bad: Invalid identifier or token. Check the link you were given.
home_coord_desc: I have an image and want to configure it or watch the machines in my room.
home_coord_hint: You usually get a ready-made link from the organization; if so, just open it. If you have the identifier and token separately, paste them here.
home_create_desc: I'll create and run the image for my lab or event.
home_docs_desc: How to prepare the season, write the USB drives, contest day and the API reference.
home_guide_admin: Administration: the administration key is shown once when the server is set up (initial setup command). With it, enter administration, open the image you want and use "view credentials and link" to copy each site's token and link — no need to recreate anything.
home_guide_coord: Coordinator: the contest organization creates your image and hands you a link with the identifier and token already embedded — opening that link is enough. If you only got the identifier and token separately, paste them in the card above.
home_intro: A USB drive powers the machine and it downloads a ready system from the server — with telemetry, screen lock and per-room configuration. It fits contests, teaching labs and managed rooms (the ICPC-style programming contest is one of the uses). Pick where to start below.
identity_duplicate: DUPLICATE IDENTITY (machine-id shared with another machine)
image_id_help: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen. Names starting with a digit are reserved for contest administration.
invites_help: Generate codes and hand them to whoever will create their own image. Each code has an image limit.
layers_help: Additional packages installed on top of the base image.
layers_section_help: Install packages on top of the base image. Building once on the template and attaching to several images saves time; or make a layer for a single image.
lock_dont_touch: Do NOT touch the mouse or the keyboard
lock_wait_message: The contest is about to start. Please wait for the staff.
locks_help: A closed padlock means only administration changes that field. It applies to Official images of this template; Free images edit everything.
logs_none: This machine has not sent any logs yet.
model_duplicate_hint: Name the new model and click Create model.
model_empty_warning: No layers: a site-image derived from this model will not boot.
model_from_help: Starting from an existing model, the new one inherits the same layers and the same form (locks included). That is how you get a new model that already has telemetry and wifi.
model_layers_help: Order is overlay priority: the first one wins. Customization layers go in front of the base image.
model_readonly: Public model owned by the administration: you can derive site-images from it, but not edit it.
model_wallpaper_help: Applies to every site of this model that has none of its own. Changing it here reaches already-created sites on the next boot.
models_none: No models yet. Create the first one above.
models_section_help: A model is what you configure once: the layers (base system, telemetry, wifi, packages) and the form each site fills in. Every site-image derives from a model.
no_machines: No machine has shown up yet.
no_token: Open this page using the link with the token (?id=…&tk=…).
pre_contest_confirm: This prepares {n} machine(s) for the contest in one shot: cleans the home directories (erases the teams' work!), locks the screens, resets the editor counters and enables the firewall. To confirm, type the number of machines:
profile_help: On official images, fields like minimum RAM, firewall, USB drives and home page can only be changed by administration.
publish_disabled_warn: Publishing is off — machines will download from the management machine itself.
publish_help: Layers and USB images are sent to the file server, so machines don't download from the management machine.
rejected_machines: {n} machine(s) tried to report with an invalid identification:
rejected_machines_hint: Probably an outdated telemetry agent — rebuild the telemetry layer and restart the machines.
report_fleet_building: Generating… the whole fleet takes a few minutes.
report_fleet_none: Not generated yet. Uses the day window chosen above.
request_intro: Without a code, leave a request: administration reviews it and sends you a code or the ready link.
request_note: Tell us what you'll use it for
request_sent: Request sent! Wait for administration to contact you.
samples_none: No history yet — samples arrive with telemetry (~45 s).
samples_truncated: History hit its cap: the oldest part has been discarded.
seeder_release_tip: Release this machine so it finishes booting
seeders_help: Machines held at boot serving the image to the others. Removing one from the list releases it to finish booting.
seeders_none: No machine is seeding right now
sound_unavailable: This browser will not play sound.
usb_auto_off: automatic generation is off (usb.auto_generate in server.json)
usb_conf_help: already filled in with this room's id and key
usb_generic_help: the same one for every site
usb_help: Machines boot from a USB drive. Write the image once and use the same drive on every machine — it is released early in the boot.
usb_howto: Write the image to the drive and copy nutellaboot.conf into it (it is a plain FAT partition, readable anywhere).
usb_no_kernel: No kernel or initrd on the management machine — without them there is no USB image. Run, as root:
usb_or: or, if you would rather not copy anything
usb_ready_made_help: nothing to copy; works only in this room
usb_section_help: One image serves every site: what changes per room is nutellaboot.conf, which each site downloads on its own screen.
usb_stale_boot_key: Out of date: the boot key changed. Drives written with it no longer boot.
usb_stale_kernel: Out of date: the boot system was rebuilt after this image.
usb_stale_server: Out of date: the server address changed after this image.
usb_title: Boot USB drive for this room
usb_wifi_help: the site's wifi networks — the same file serves the boot and the system
wallpaper_help: Upload a PNG or JPEG. The file stays on the server; you don't need to host it anywhere.
wallpaper_locked_msg: The wallpaper of this image was set by the organization.
wallpaper_preview_failed: Could not load the wallpaper preview.
wallpaper_upload_failed: The image was created, but the wallpaper was not uploaded
who_admin_help: You see and manage everything, and yours is the only account that may use names starting with a digit.
who_subadmin_help: You see and manage only what you created. Names starting with a digit are reserved for the administration.
owners_help: People who joined by invite and have their own console. Suspending cuts console access without deleting the invite or orphaning anything.
owners_none: Nobody has joined by invite yet.
owner_quotas_prompt: Quotas: models, images and builds (three numbers)
invite_expires_prompt: Expires in how many days? (empty = unchanged, 0 = never)
invite_expires_bad: Days must be a whole number.
invite_delete_confirm: Delete the invite? Prefer revoking: deleting is permanent.
invite_delete_force: Delete anyway? What was listed becomes ownerless.
keys_section_help: The credentials the administration issues. Every key is shown once, on creation; the server keeps only the hash.
key_shown_once: Save it now: this key is not shown again.
adminkey_current_help: The key you signed in with
adminkey_revoke_confirm: Revoke key {id}? Sessions opened with it end immediately.
adminkey_revoke_self_confirm: This is the key you signed in with. To revoke it, type {id}:
adminkey_last_one: This is the last admin key: create another before revoking it.
reauth_help: Creating or revoking an administration key asks for the key you signed in with. It is used for this request only and is not stored.
reauth_bad: That is not this session's key.
svckey_images_help: Space separated, like 26br* 26bo*. Empty = every image. One key per event is recommended.
svckey_need_name_scope: Enter the name and tick at least one scope.
svckey_exists: A key with that name already exists: rotate or revoke it.
svckey_rotate_confirm: Issue a new key for {name}? The current one stops working immediately.
svckey_follow_help: Shows what the administration chose in the fleet view
audit_help: What was done to keys and invites, by whom and from where. No secret is recorded.
bkey_help: This is the key that goes in the USB drive's nutellaboot.conf. Changing it requires updating the site's USB drives.
bkey_rotate_confirm: Rotate the boot key? This site's USB drives stop booting until they are updated.
bkey_rotated: Boot key rotated. Generate the USB image again.
mkey_rotate_help: A machine only receives the key at boot. During the grace period the old key still works, so running machines do not go silent.
mkey_rotate_confirm: Rotate the machine key? The old one works for {h} more hours.
mkey_rotate_confirm_none: Rotate with NO grace? Running machines stop reporting and receiving orders until they reboot.
mkey_rotated: Key rotated. {online} running machine(s) keep the old one until they reboot.
fview_saved: View saved: applies to the dashboard, the labs and the big screen.
fview_pick_first: Tick the sites on the labs screen before saving.
